layers.name: HUMAN_SCOPE_AND_OVERRIDE
layers.purpose: Current explicit owner constraints, approvals and conversation-bounded exceptions.

layers.name: DEVELOPMENT_EXECUTION_DISCIPLINE
layers.purpose: Blocker, scope, freshness, overlap, workflow, mutation-reporting and exact-head discipline for CFA3 development.

layers.name: TASK_AND_ORCHESTRATION
layers.purpose: Task lifecycle, bounded scope, orchestration and guard-chain behavior.

layers.name: SECURITY_AND_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION
layers.purpose: Execution security, side-effect authorization and fail-closed effect boundaries.

layers.name: MODEL_POLICY
layers.purpose: Model-development, model-selection and model/runtime recommendation behavior.

layers.name: PROJECTION_UX_AND_COMPATIBILITY

development_rules.name: BLOCKER_IS_IMMEDIATE_STOP
development_rules.requirement: Conflict, changed main, failed gate, uncertain state, overlapping work or unexpected CI causes immediate STOP and report.

development_rules.name: NO_AUTONOMOUS_WORKAROUND
development_rules.requirement: After a blocker, no autonomous rebase, workflow, replacement PR, component change, bypass or alternative route.

development_rules.name: THREAD_SCOPE_LOCK
development_rules.requirement: A conversation may affect only the explicitly scoped task files, PRs and directly authorized dependencies.

development_rules.name: FRESH_STATE_BEFORE_WRITE
development_rules.requirement: Before every GitHub mutation re-check main SHA, target head and relevant open PR state.

development_rules.name: OVERLAP_IS_BLOCKER
development_rules.requirement: Concurrent modification of the same canonical file, gate, workflow or exclusive resource is a blocker unless explicitly owner-overridden for this conversation.

development_rules.name: NO_AUTOMATIC_WORKFLOW_OR_GATE_START
development_rules.requirement: Start a workflow or gate only when required for task closure and only when no equivalent run is already active.

development_rules.name: REPORT_AFTER_EVERY_MUTATION
development_rules.requirement: After each mutation report what changed, current SHA, next step and blocker status.

development_rules.name: EXACT_HEAD_BEFORE_MERGE
development_rules.requirement: Merge requires exact checked head and base/main; any drift blocks merge.

development_rules.name: NO_SILENT_REDESIGN_OR_REPAIR
development_rules.requirement: Unexpected conditions requiring redesign or repair must be reported before changing strategy.

development_rules.name: CURRENT_OWNER_RESTRICTION_WINS
development_rules.requirement: Current explicit owner restrictions override earlier autonomy grants and broader approvals.

ai_behavior_rules.name: STOP_ON_BLOCKER
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: AI execution stops on a blocker and reports it before any further side effect.

ai_behavior_rules.name: NO_AUTONOMOUS_BYPASS
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: An AI may not infer permission to bypass a blocker from the user's end goal.

ai_behavior_rules.name: ACTIVE_SCOPE_BINDING
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: AI execution must carry explicit task scope, allowed/forbidden actions and applicable overrides.

ai_behavior_rules.name: FRESH_STATE_BEATS_MEMORY
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: Live verified state outranks remembered or cached repository, workflow and runtime state.

ai_behavior_rules.name: CROSS_AGENT_COLLISION_DETECTION
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: Conflicting concurrent work by another agent, task or PR blocks mutating execution.

ai_behavior_rules.name: EXPLICIT_SIDE_EFFECT_LEVEL
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: READ, ANALYZE, PLAN, WRITE, COMMIT, PUSH, PR, WORKFLOW, GATE, MERGE, RELEASE and EXTERNAL_ACTION permissions do not imply one another.

ai_behavior_rules.name: MUTATION_AUDIT
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: Every state-changing AI operation requires an attributable audit record.

ai_behavior_rules.name: EXACT_STATE_COMMITMENT
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: An authorization based on a concrete state expires when that state materially changes.

ai_behavior_rules.name: UNCERTAINTY_IS_BLOCKER
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: Unknown current state, authority, scope ownership or approval validity fails closed.

ai_behavior_rules.name: LATEST_OWNER_CONSTRAINT_PRIORITY
ai_behavior_rules.requirement: Current explicit owner restrictions override earlier model autonomy and execution permissions.
